# Admin Dashboard Improvement Plan

- Add a more polished hero/header area with live store metrics.
- Rework the KPI cards to be more visual, clearer, and more actionable.
- Add quick-action shortcuts for common admin tasks:
  - Manage Products
  - Review Orders
  - Edit Categories
  - View Customers
  - Browse Catalog
- Add a store health panel with operational indicators:
  - inventory health
  - active catalog rate
  - category coverage
- Improve the recent products section with better metadata, empty state, and stronger spacing.
- Improve the category breakdown section with clearer progress visualization and empty state.
- Improve the recent orders section with better date display, clearer badges, and empty state.
- Replace any incorrect dashboard copy so it matches the Furniture Store brand and tone.
- Keep the update aligned with the current Inertia + React + Tailwind v4 component style.

## Suggested visual direction
- Cleaner executive-dashboard layout
- Softer card hierarchy
- More whitespace and stronger section separation
- Subtle gradients and progress bars
- Better empty states and call-to-action buttons

## Success criteria
- Dashboard feels more modern and useful at a glance.
- Key metrics are easier to scan.
- Admin actions are easier to reach.
- Empty states and edge cases are handled gracefully.
